input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit right binding us (no other inspection, verification or monitoring rights appear in the document; § 23 has no operative text). It meets the preferred position in full: audits limited to once in any twelve-month period, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, with Vendor bearing costs unless the audit establishes underpayment exceeding five percent, and an express bar on Vendor or its auditor accessing Customer systems directly. Section 22.3 additionally treats findings as our Confidential Information, which favours us. No redline required.
